summary: AVSAR team member struck in the right leg by a dislodged rock slab while searching a couloir on Gash Ridge, Blanca Peak, during the Vaughn Fetzer mission; extracted by helicopter, evaluated by EMS and Emergency Room physicians; search called off that day
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer Search and Rescue (helicopter extraction; EMS)
notes: Run 673 backfill (Monte Vista Journal); AVSAR rescuer injury during the Vaughn Fetzer search (see id 2877); MVJ 9-29-2021 p. 7A states "Thursday, Sept. 24" — weekday/date mismatch, Thursday = 2021-09-23 (recorded date); parent-opened PDF.
